liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Dark Star** (3 reviews): The performance is characterized as magnificent, long, jazzy, and intricate in its execution; John Scott described the performance as a thinking man's Dark Star in Deadbase [9][11][16]
- **El Paso** (1 review): The performance is called the best El Paso, played with intensity and passion [15]
- **Mind Left Body Jam** (1 review): The jam is cited as the most intense and focused version the reviewer has heard [12]

## The recordings

- **gd73-11-11.sbd.schlissel.14105.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 25 songs; 191 min; rated 4.86/5 by 43 [1]. Said about its sound: The recording is described as solid, jazzy, and well-jammed throughout the entire performance [9]
- **gd1973-11-11.sbd.rolfe-miller.83318.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 25 songs; 191 min; rated 4.9/5 by 10 [2]
- **gd1973-11-11.sbd.pitch-corrected.miller.88485.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 25 songs; 190 min; rated 4.54/5 by 13 [3]
- **gd1973-11-11.sbd.gardner.12178.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 25 songs; 191 min; rated 4.5/5 by 8 [4]

## Around the show

- This was the final night of a three-night run at the Winterland venue [11]
- The show is ranked alongside the August 27, 1972, and September 21, 1972, concerts [10]
- The Dark Star is ranked number one among third stage performances from 1972 to 1974 [18]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd73-11-11.sbd.schlissel.14105.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [1]. Also: Tony Gardner fixed the seed using shntool, transferring from MSR to DATs and CDRs [1]
- **gd1973-11-11.sbd.rolfe-miller.83318.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Cassette -> Dat (44.1k) D [2]. Also: Steve Rolfe lent DATs for the transfer, which includes more tuning before Dark Star [2]
- **gd1973-11-11.sbd.pitch-corrected.miller.88485.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Cassette -> Dat (44.1k) D [3]. Also: Rob Bertrando helped pitch-correct the audio by 0.9% using Cool Edit Pro [3]
- **gd1973-11-11.sbd.gardner.12178.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Darrin Sacks and Tony Gardner; source: Disks 1-2 MSR>Cass>Cass>DATs>CDRs>EAC>SHN. Disk 3 MSR>Cass>DATs>CDRs>EAC>SHN [4]. Also: Ben Neuman provided a patch for the Eyes section, fixed with shntool [4]

## Art and photos

- Photo by a Flickr member (All rights reserved): [Grateful Dead - 11/11/73 Winterland Arena, San Fra…](https://www.flickr.com/photos/104729480@N03/27364594275/) [21]
- Photo by uncredited: [the page](https://www.flickr.com/photos/104729480@N03/27364594275/) [22]
